future_check: selfcheck-minimal-impostor (all_background/full_one_color/singleton/solid_2x2/short_line accepted): lawful by design — all-zero is the declared no_container degenerate (oracle idle, Racket-verified) and small non-container objects are the declared no_piece/distractor grammars (the rule fills what it can). Nearest-invalid shapes are rejected: hole-less containers, multi-cell color-5 distractors, out-of-envelope dims.; selfcheck-power: the accepted mutation classes are exactly the declared degenerate grammars above (oracle-verified); structure-destroying mutations outside them are rejected (hole-less containers, 5-blobs, envelope breaks).
rationale: v4.1.0 monitor-failure repair: (1) k-split now guarantees EVERY container hole gets >= 1 partition piece whenever n_pieces >= 2 (k2=0 left one hole uncoverable and sent the rule's DFS into an exhaustive >10s proof — the run_one seed-6 lint_generator crash); (2) every emitted draw must pass _quick_cover_ok, a bounded (3000-expansion) faithful replica of the rule's exact-cover search (same hole order, first-uncovered-cell descent, big-pieces-first with original-bbox/color tie-break, greedy per-hole commit), so the oracle always terminates fast; (3) _components now groups same-color cells (mirrors find-objects), fixing container/piece classification when different-color objects touch
summary: Containers are non-5 objects that enclose holes; loose non-5 objects are pieces. A DFS solver tiles each container hole with the loose pieces and paints the hole accordingly; the loose pieces are removed.
